# WebFX

> > WebFX is a digital marketing agency that shares web design tutorials, Photoshop and Illustrator guides, design resources, and business insights for designers and developers.

The site features comprehensive tutorials for Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator), free design resources including PSD templates and texture packs, and practical advice for web design businesses. WebFX also shares company culture updates and insights on modern web development practices using tools like Google Web Fundamentals.

## Key Topics

- Web Design
- Photoshop Tutorials
- Graphic Design
- Adobe Illustrator
- PSD Templates
- Design Resources
- Free Templates
- Background Patterns
- Portfolio Design
- Web Development
- Usability Testing
- Typography
- Photography
- Digital Art
- Company Culture

- [Surreal Smoking Bird Composition | Photoshop Tutorial](https://www.webfx.com/blog/web-design/creating-a-surreal-smoking-bird-composition-in-photoshop): Photoshop tutorial for monochromatic surreal bird composition
- [Create a Funky Urban-Inspired Scene in Photoshop](https://www.webfx.com/blog/web-design/create-a-funky-urban-inspired-scene-in-photoshop): Photoshop tutorial for colorful urban break-dancing scene design
